# BTicino C300X Integration v3.0.0b1

## 2026-11-25

Beta. 3.0.0b1 puts the Classe 300X and the Classe 100X into one package and
includes all of **2.10.0**. Everything below is new against 2.10.0.

On a Classe 300X (firmware 1.7.x, 2.0.2 and 3.0.6) it works like 2.10.0, apart
from the changes listed under **Classe 300X**. That was compared offline, with
the display files of the three firmwares; this beta has not run on a station
yet.

The Classe 100X support (firmware 1.5.8) is **experimental**: it is built and
checked against the original firmware files offline only and is not yet
confirmed on a Classe 100X. Testing it is tracked in
[issue #51](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/issues/51).

## Classe 300X

- **Names without the model.** The card picker lists the card as **BTicino
  Doorbell Call Card** (before: C300X Doorbell Call Card). The blueprints are
  called **BTicino ...** instead of **C300X ...**, their device input is called
  **Door station**, and the services are listed without "C300X" in their names
  (for example **Run action** instead of Run C300X action). Only the displayed
  names changed: the card type `custom:c300x-doorbell-call-card`, the service
  IDs, the blueprint files and every entity stay as they are, so existing
  dashboards and automations keep working without a change.
- Manual setup says **C300X/C100X** in its texts until the station has
  answered and its model is known.
- The device page shows the station's board as hardware version and its article
  number as model ID.
- **Installation over SSH:**
  - When Home Assistant cannot install its SSH package but a usable one is
    already there, the installation goes on with it. When none can be loaded,
    setup says so in a message of its own instead of reporting a login error.
  - While the model is still unknown, setup tries the C100X factory password
    after the station refused the C300X one, before it asks for a login.
  - A station without the firewall file `/etc/network/if-pre-up.d/iptables` is
    installed with firewall management switched off instead of failing. Where
    that file or a directory above it is a link, the installation stops before
    it changes anything. On the Classe 300X firmwares 1.7.19, 2.0.2 and 3.0.6
    the file is a regular file, so nothing changes there.
- The native agent is rebuilt as **3.0.0b1**; an agent update is required.

## Classe 100X (experimental)

- Setup recognises a Classe 100X on firmware 1.5.8 and installs nothing on it
  until you confirm the experimental support in the setup dialog. A Classe
  300X is never asked.
- What the model offers:
  [Models and Features](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.0.0b1/docs/feature-reference.md#models-and-features).
- The display pages come as a separate adapter that one reboot activates,
  operated with the station's keys:
  [Classe 100X: Activation by Reboot](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.0.0b1/docs/display.md#classe-100x-activation-by-reboot).
- With active display pages, the agent update Repair renews
  the pages when the update brings newer ones: the station reboots once, after
  it has been idle for about two minutes, never during a call and only while
  the maintenance reboot is allowed. A station with the original display is
  not rebooted.
- Before the first installation make the private backup, then follow the test
  plan and its stop conditions:
  [Testing a Classe 100X](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.0.0b1/docs/c100x-experimental.md#testing-a-classe-100x).

## Still Unverified on a Device

- Everything on a Classe 100X: installation, calls, stream, picture controls,
  the display activation by reboot and its rollback.
- This beta on a Classe 300X station; the comparison with 2.10.0 ran offline.

## Update and Downgrade

1. Back up Home Assistant and read the beta limitations.
2. Select **3.0.0b1** with Marketplace **Pre-release** or HACS beta versions
   enabled. Stable installations are not switched automatically.
3. Complete the agent update Repair: this release includes a rebuilt
   **3.0.0b1** agent.

To leave the beta on a Classe 300X, disable pre-releases, select the stable
release and run the agent update Repair again. On firmware 3.0.6, before going
back to a release older than 2.10.0, fully remove the display overlay with
`qml_patch.sh restore-all` first. No stable release supports a Classe 100X: to
leave the beta there, remove the agent, which also restores the original
display
([Routing and Removal](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.0.0b1/docs/c100x-experimental.md#routing-and-removal)).
